nodes.label: Candidate Mechanisms Ranking
nodes.content: Horizontal bar chart: Candidate Mechanisms for Phase 2 Causal Experiments with Evidence Scores. Segment Stability scores highest (~0.78, significant FDR<0.05 in 2/6 configs, mean |d|=0.88). Silhouette Score (~0.40, direction consistent 100%). Boundary Sharpness (~0.38, mean |d|=0.58). Intra-class Compactness (~0.30, no strong signal). Ranks candidate causal mechanisms for wav2sem lip-sync quality investigation.

nodes.label: Wav2Sem Causal Mechanisms
nodes.content: Four candidate causal mechanisms for lip-sync quality: Segment Stability (strongest evidence, |d|=0.88, FDR<0.05 in 2/6 configs), Silhouette Score (direction consistent 100%), Boundary Sharpness (|d|=0.58), Intra-class Compactness (no strong signal). Used to prioritize Phase 2 causal experiments investigating why TTS lip-sync differs from natural speech at the viseme level.
